sources.transformation: Select declared plant; sort source timestamps; serialize all original Parquet columns as semicolon CSV. No interpolation or observations generated.
Select declared plant; sort source timestamps; serialize all original Parquet columns as semicolon CSV. No interpolation or observations generated.

attribution: Operador Nacional do Sistema Eletrico (ONS), CC-BY; selections identified.
plant_selection: Solar PBFCM4 is the first plant in native export order with 672 initial training records, >=650 valid resource flags and >=150 valid readings above 100 W/m2. This excludes degenerate all-zero sensors despite valid flags. Wind MAEDT1 is the first wind plant in the native export. Selection used only the initial 14-day training inputs, never model errors or test-period quality.
clock: America/Sao_Paulo source reference labels converted to UTC without shifting. Interval start/end is not asserted. Issue is last available historical source label.
target_unit: MWmed (mean MW over the native half hour), not MWh
resource_policy: Invalid resource flags mask training covariates. Solar forecasts reuse the latest valid same-clock observation; wind uses the last valid observation.
wind_unit_assumption: The ONS PDF calls val_ventoverificado wind speed but prints m3/s. This dimensional inconsistency is retained here; the cubic-curve benchmark explicitly interprets the native numerical speeds as m/s. No volumetric-flow conversion.
solar_assumptions: Measured irradiance is a POA proxy of undocumented sensor-plane orientation. No temperature observation is provided; the physical surrogate fixes 25 C.
availability_assumption: Historical SCADA generation and resource are assumed available at their labels for this experiment. Exports include post-operation revisions; this is not a verified as-issued operational backtest.
